functionalRequirement: System shall set over temperature values to prevent temperature deviations beyond 3 degrees Fahrenheit.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operational Constraint: The system must implement automatic shutdown or warning mechanisms if temperature exceeds the 3-degree Fahrenheit deviation threshold.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents potential equipment damage or safety risks from temperature fluctuations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must maintain temperature monitoring accuracy within ±0.5 degrees Fahrenheit under varying environmental conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise temperature control and deviation detection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Temperature monitoring and deviation detection must occur with a maximum latency of 100 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Rapid response is critical for preventing temperature-related issues.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must log all temperature override attempts with user credentials and timestamp.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides accountability for temperature control interventions.

functionalRequirement: System shall show the first lines of news articles based on the titles on the title screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: News article preview lines must load within 2 seconds for up to 10 concurrent article titles.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive display of news previews.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement graceful handling for articles with no preview text, displaying a default 'No preview available' message.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides clear user feedback for incomplete article information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: The system must support retrieving preview text from at least three different news source APIs or RSS feeds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures flexibility in news content sourcing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: Preview text must accurately represent the first 100 characters of the article content, preserving full words.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides meaningful and coherent article previews.
